data.body: Full make test reached 100% with 11,683 passed, 44 skipped, 256 deselected and three failures, all caused by two intentionally removed functions remaining in the shrink-only complexity baseline. Ran the canonical --update-stale maintenance command; it removed only those two vanished entries and reported active=66 new=0 increased=0 stale=0. The focused complexity-baseline suite then passed 72/72. Additional caller/continuity paths beyond the signed file-impact are derived updates: .github/workflows/reconcile-bridge-canary.yml, CHANGELOG.md, docs/cli-reference.md, docs/jira-sync-setup.md, docs/output-schemas.md, tests/scripts/test_canary_bridge.py, tests/scripts/test_canary_bridge_heldout.py, and tests/scripts/bridge/test_bridge_fsck_keyset_prev_heldout.py.
